offering_description.value: Develops and manufactures specialty ingredients for human nutrition, animal nutrition and health, and specialty chemicals. Sells to food, beverage, supplement, pharmaceutical, animal feed, agricultural and industrial customers. Produces through chemical processing, encapsulation and blending at its own plants.

primary_products.value: encapsulated food ingredients; choline nutrients for human and animal nutrition; mineral amino acid chelates; ethylene oxide sterilant gas; micronutrient fertilizers

customer_segment.value: B2B: food and beverage makers, supplement and pharma firms, animal feed producers, medical device sterilizers, agricultural and industrial users

end_markets.value: food and beverage; dietary supplements; animal feed and nutrition; pharmaceuticals; medical device sterilization; agriculture

revenue_model.value: product sales: specialty ingredients and chemicals sold to manufacturers and distributors

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: processes chemical and nutrient raw materials into specialty ingredients sold to food, feed, health and industrial manufacturers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia and other international markets, with plants in the US and Europe

specialization.value: related lines: human nutrition and food, animal nutrition and health, and specialty products such as sterilants and plant nutrition

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales to large food, feed and pharma manufacturers; distributors / dealers: ingredient and chemical distributors serving smaller customers and regional markets

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: food and feed ingredient safety rules (FDA, EFSA), EPA rules for ethylene oxide and pesticides, chemical and environmental regulation
